execution_scope.finite_range: Row 493, columns 10001 through 22000 inclusive, in two disjoint executed segments.
execution_scope.append_reuse: The append retains all 10000 initial classification records, all 1900 local rules and the complete 16385-entry basis array. It evaluates and sieves only 2000 new column values.
execution_scope.complete_data: Both complete stage snapshots are independently loadable. Every row value, prime position and composite least-divisor/quotient witness is retained, together with complete basis factors, all local rule cases and both full rule-usage tables.
execution_scope.reader: A third fresh module context structurally loaded the final snapshot and made six saved queries with no basis, modular-root, modular-power or row-sieve calls.
execution_scope.timing_scope: Individual Date.now observations only. The final query batch recorded 0 ms at that clock's resolution; this is not a claim of zero execution time or a statistical benchmark.
